:::{#def-reducible-risk}
#### Reducible risk

In the squared-error risk decomposition of @thm-risk-decomposition,
the part of the [risk](#def-risk) that comes from choosing the [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$ instead of the [conditional mean](#def-cond-expectation-function),

$$\E{\sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}} \ge 0$$

is the **reducible risk**.

:::
